text: Figure 2.7: Optimized insertion of copy routines The presence of the guard macros directly supports reuse on the level of source code. Reuse on the level of object code is only possible if the scheduling scenario (in terms of the assignment of RunnableEntitys to priority levels) does not change. This concept can only be implemented properly with the aid of a code generator if the variables in question can be identified. In other words: the description of an AtomicSwComponentType has to expose all concurrently accessed variables to the outside world.
